liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: London, College of Arms, MS Vincent 98

others.text: Not used by Liebermann. Found by Bruce

O’Brien (God’s Peace and King’s Peace, 1999, 138–9). A 16th-century transcript of a lost manuscript, probably the same one as BL Harley 785 was copied from. O’Brien counts it an independent witness to the Instituta Cnuti (short text, Huntingdon class) and places it with Pl and Harley 785 under the lost π; in his family tree it is ‘Ar’. Liebermann’s own Ar is a College of Arms manuscript of ECf retr that he could not find; whether the two are the same MS has not been checked.
